quests.name: Valley of Bones
quests.text: Improve your reputation with the Gelkis, and locate Nerlokh near the Valley of Bones far east of Gelkis Village.

quests.name: Ravaging Ravagers
quests.text: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan and slay 6 Undead Ravagers, then return to Nerlokh at the southern entrance to Valley of Bones.

quests.name: Facing the Truth
quests.text: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan, and bring an Accursed Skull and Gelkis Necromantic Garb to Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village.

quests.name: Valley of Bones
quests.text: Improve your reputation with the Magram, and locate Orgrul near the Valley of Bones south of Magram Village.

quests.name: Outcast Necromancers
quests.text: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and slay Outcast Necromancers within the Valley of Bones.

quests.name: Bone Raising
quests.text: Maintain your reputation with the Magram Clan, and use the Enhanced Necromancy Staff to fully raise undead that are struggling to emerge throughout the Valley of Bones. Return to Orgrul once the Magram army has grown.

quests.name: Outing Outcasts
quests.text: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan, and bring 1 Necromantic Garb to Nerlokh at the entrance of the Valley of Bones.

quests.name: Proof of Concept
quests.text: Maintain your reputation with the Magram Clan, then bring 426 Well Cursed Bones from a successful ritual back to Orgrul.

quests.name: Mountain of Bones
quests.text: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 426 Gently Cursed Bones to Orgrul south of the Magram Village in Desolace.

quests.name: Corrupting Tears
quests.text: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 3 Petrified Bark and 3 Imbued Tears back to Orgrul.

quests.name: No Mercy for the Weak
quests.text: Maintain your reputation with the Magram Clan, and slay 5 Gelkis Captives scattered around the Valley of Bones. Return to Orgrul after the task is complete.

quests.name: Saving Our Own
quests.text: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis clan, and rescue 5 Gelkis Captives within the Valley of Bones. Return to Nerlokh near the entrance when you are done.

quests.name: Bone Burying
quests.text: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan, and dispel the curses from 8 failed summons throughout the Valley of Bones.

quests.name: Bristleback Retreat
quests.text: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and slay quilboar at Bristleback Retreat. Then report to Hagiak at the Magram Front on the other side of Valley of Bones in Desolace.

quests.name: Long-Term Solutions
quests.text: Maintain your reputation with the Magram clan and slay 2 Outcast Scouts, 6 Outcast Marauders, and 8 Outcast Necromancers then return to Hagiak at the Magram Front.

quests.name: Going Home
quests.text: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and escort Rokren out of the Outcast Hideaway. Then inform Nerlokh near the Valley of Bones about what happened.

quests.name: Threat of Starvation
quests.text: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 6 Stolen Supplies back to Hagiak at the Magram Front.

quests.name: Return to Orgrul
quests.text: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and report back to Orgrul near the northern entrance to Valley of Bones.

quests.name: Checking Things Out
quests.text: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and investigate centaur points of interest within Shen'dralas. Then return to Nerlokh at the entrance of Valley of Bones with your findings.
